name: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Lesser Agility
summary: A transferable writ asks you to obtain an Elixir of Lesser Agility for a customer. It gives a delivery location and payment details.

sections.title: A Customer's Request
sections.body: A customer seeks an Elixir of Lesser Agility through this faded-ink writ. You are asked to acquire the requested item and bring it to the marked location; the writ must be with you to complete the transaction.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The customer requests one Elixir of Lesser Agility.
The writ points to a delivery location marked on your map.

faq.q: Does the writ say how payment works?
faq.answer: The writ includes information about payment.

faq.q: Can someone else carry the writ?
faq.answer: Yes. Text at the bottom says the writ is transferable.

faq.q: Do I need the writ to complete the delivery?
faq.answer: Yes. You need to have the writ with you to complete the transaction.
